contention_probe.tool: nvidia-smi pmon -c 3 followed by nvidia-smi pmon -c 10 -s um
contention_probe.interpretation: The thirteen-second probes did not directly observe external SM use, but they cannot establish that the process was inactive throughout the affected portion of progan or later domains.

observation_failures: The first child-process detail query used a malformed remote awk expression. It failed without changing any process and was immediately repeated successfully with ps --ppid.

assessment.timing_validity: The first fourteen completed domains are clean. Conservatively mark progan from approximately iteration 450 onward as potentially shared-compute contaminated until continued probes establish a tighter boundary.
assessment.experiment_action: Continue without restart or result selection, preserve the external process, raw monitor, clean fourteen-domain boundary, and timing qualification.
assessment.conclusion: The external process explains the new A6000 host-memory plateau. It was observed only and not modified; completed prediction results remain usable while progan timing and later host-memory claims are qualified.
